# Configuration

<!-- Generated by `python -m mebot.config --markdown`; do not edit by hand. -->

All settings are environment variables (or lines in `.env`). In the Docker image
`DATA_DIR=/data` and `FRONTEND_DIST=/app/static` are preset.

| Variable | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MODE` | `single` | single = one bot, no tenancy. hosted = multi-bot (later releases). |
| `SECRET_KEY` | *(unset)* | Encrypts stored API keys and keys the IP hashes. Required when MODE=hosted; in single mode one is generated once into <DATA_DIR>/secret.key. Changing it means re-entering API keys. |
| `DATA_DIR` | `backend/data` | Directory for the SQLite db and the generated secret key. |
| `DATABASE_URL` | *(unset)* | Defaults to sqlite:///<data_dir>/mebot.db when unset. |
| `TELEMETRY` | `on` | "off" = no heartbeat, registration or update check: zero network calls to the registry. |
| `REGISTRY_URL` | `https://registry.shivanshmishra.in` | Where heartbeats / registrations go. Read once at startup. |
| `TELEMETRY_WORKERS` | `true` | Background telemetry jobs (heartbeat, registration, update check). Tests turn them off. |
| `OLLAMA_HOST` | `http://127.0.0.1:11434` | Only the suggested base URL for the "ollama" provider; the model and provider are chosen in setup / Admin -> AI Provider. |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | `http://localhost:5173` | Comma-separated allowed browser origins (also used by the admin CSRF origin check). |
| `SETUP_TOKEN` | *(unset)* | If set, POST /api/setup must include a matching setup_token. Recommended when the first boot is reachable from the internet. |
| `COOKIE_SECURE` | `false` | Force the Secure flag on auth cookies (set when TLS terminates at a reverse proxy). |
| `TRUST_PROXY` | `false` | Trust X-Forwarded-Proto / X-Forwarded-For from a reverse proxy. |
| `TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` | *(unset)* | Optional Cloudflare Turnstile on new chats (also needs the toggle in Admin -> Limits). |
| `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` | *(unset)* | Server-side Turnstile secret, paired with TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY. |
| `PUBLIC_URL` | *(unset)* | Public base URL (https://bot.example.com). Enables the Telegram webhook option and "Open chat" links in notifications. |
| `TELEGRAM_WORKERS` | `true` | Background Telegram tasks (poller, outbox, digest). Tests turn them off. |
| `FRONTEND_DIST` | `frontend/dist` | Built frontend (npm run build). When it holds an index.html the backend serves the whole UI (app, embed bundle, widget loader) with per-path cache headers. |
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | *(unset)* | Optional token for GitHub imports (public data only; raises the 60/hour limit). A token saved in Admin -> Import takes precedence. |
| `RETRIEVAL_THRESHOLD_TOKENS` | `6000` | Profiles above this many (estimated) tokens are not sent whole: only the parts relevant to each question are. Per-bot override in Admin -> Knowledge (auto / always / off). |
| `RETRIEVAL_BUDGET_TOKENS` | `2500` | Token budget for the retrieved profile excerpts in one prompt. |
